title: Visual enhancements: Hot badge, expanded ReactionBar, post card polish
acceptance_criteria: 🔥 Hot badge: appears on topic cards in ForumPage when topic has >5 replies OR >10 reactions (need reply_count/reaction_count — can compute from posts array length or add a derived display)
Hot badge uses CSS `@keyframes pulse-glow` animation (subtle orange glow)
ReactionBar: existing emoji buttons have CSS hover: scale(1.15) with 150ms transition
ReactionBar: '+😊' add button replaced with '＋' pill for cleaner look
MessageCard (post cards): new posts (<1 hour old) get a subtle gradient left-border (linear-gradient from accent-primary to transparent)
MessageCard: improved visual hierarchy — slightly larger username, muted timestamp, 2px more padding
All new CSS uses Tailwind classes where possible; custom CSS in forum.css only for animations/gradients
